## Purpose

Describe one primary change and the models/firmware versions it covers.

## Inputs

- Base artifact/version:
- Base size:
- Base SHA-256:
- Tool version/commit:

## Changes

- Components/files:
- Addresses/functions/resources:
- Patch or build command:

## Verification

- [ ] Container/checksum validation
- [ ] Diff limited to declared range
- [ ] Round-trip or reproducible build
- [ ] Static analysis
- [ ] Virtual/emulated test, with coverage stated
- [ ] Hardware test, with exact device combination
- [ ] Recovery test

Paste literal test output or link the corresponding report/manifest.

## Evidence status

- [ ] `hardware-verified`
- [ ] `static-verified`
- [ ] `experimental`
- [ ] `superseded`
- [ ] `withdrawn`

## Recovery

Record the known base artifact, procedure, result, and restored functions.

## Documentation

- [ ] Manifest updated

- [ ] Report or rationale linked
